ABOUT RS BRIDAL

Beauty That Feels Like You

Personalised bridal artistry for your most meaningful celebrations.

RS Bridal is built around one simple idea — every bride should feel like the most confident and beautiful version of herself on her wedding day. Each look is thoughtfully planned around the bride's features, outfit, jewellery, occasion, and personal preference rather than following one fixed makeup style.

Originally from Trichy and primarily serving bridal clients in Chennai, RS Bridal accepts wedding and beauty bookings across Tamil Nadu. Whether the celebration is intimate or grand, the focus remains on creating an elegant, comfortable, and timeless look that feels truly personal to the bride.

GOT QUESTIONS?

Frequently Asked Questions

Have a question not listed here? Reach out on WhatsApp with your date, city, venue and service requirement.

Tell the artist about sensitivities, allergies and products that have caused reactions before the event. Product choices and any trial or patch-test process should be discussed directly with the artist before the booking date.

The final timing depends on the makeup look, hair styling, saree or dupatta draping, accessories and the event schedule. Share your ready-time with the artist early so the preparation slot can be planned without rushing.

Yes. Chennai is the primary work area, and venue-based bridal bookings can be discussed for cities and districts across Tamil Nadu. Share your date, city and venue so availability can be confirmed for your event.

Trial availability is a client-confirmation item for this website. Ask on WhatsApp with your wedding date and preferred look so the artist can confirm whether a trial session is available and how it is priced.

Yes, family-function and party-makeup enquiries can be collected together. Share the number of people, event time and location to receive the most suitable group plan and quote.

The quote can vary based on service type, number of looks, hair and draping requirements, number of people, event timing and any add-ons. The website therefore keeps pricing enquiry-based until the client approves final packages.
